notes.title: UPTADE v0.3
WITCH'S UPDATE
WITCH'S AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Still in development, Witch's is an action/adventure game with simple and intuitive mechanics, with the ability to send you to a magical and fantasy world where a witch has cursed a kingdom called Farheim. Amid countless obstacles and enemies, you'll have to find a way to reach the witch at the top of the castle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43188702/a1be98b4c9ecc4db71a13deb9e4bacbe968e5ba5.jpg[/img]
